findings.description: Phase 16 history contains a checkpoint commit despite the success criterion requiring zero checkpoint commits for this phase.
findings.evidence: git log --oneline 5ffaa64..HEAD --grep='checkpoint:' returned 316512e checkpoint: before next-loop cycle

failure_notes: Do not create checkpoint commits during the retry; use checkpoint/loop-NNN lightweight tags only.
Re-run the phase-history check with git log --oneline 5ffaa64..HEAD --grep='checkpoint:' and require no Phase 16 checkpoint commits before gate.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: install_audit.py reports all three layers current on this machine after /sync-install; CI runs the source↔project check and blocks on drift.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: source/project verified current by python -m platforms.python.install_audit --layers source,project --root .; CI has .github/workflows/ci.yml:111 running source,project. Global ~/.claude layer is outside reviewer scope.

criteria_outcomes.evidence: Static coverage present in platforms/python/tests/test_install_audit.py for stale detection and EOL-insensitivity, but executable pytest verification was blocked by read-only sandbox temp-file failure.
